Some of your key responsibilities 
 
Graduate Programme:

jobs.occupation: Paid Social Media Lead - Marketing Activation
jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO  
As Global Paid Social Media Lead, you’ll own and develop the Paid Social channel, driving best-in-class activation across platforms while enabling markets and teams to deliver strong performance and continuous improvement.
This is a highly visible role where deep Paid Social expertise goes hand in hand with commercial thinking and the ability to influence at senior level. You’ll move comfortably between platform detail and the bigger business picture, setting direction for the channel and turning performance and insights into recommendations that move the business forward.
You’ll combine strategic direction with hands-on expertise, ensuring consistent execution and innovation across our global Paid Social ecosystem.
Your key responsibilities include:
Own the global Paid Social setup, including channel strategy, activation principles and ways of working.
Define, maintain and evolve best practices across formats and platforms such as Meta and TikTok.
Ensure consistent application of Paid Social best practices across markets and agency partners.
Define and prioritise Test & Learn initiatives, scaling proven approaches globally.
Collaborate closely with platform partners to drive innovation and capability development.
Align the Paid Social development agenda with cross-channel media initiatives.
Work closely with internal teams such as Creative Production and Measurement & Analytics to enable effective Paid Social activation.
Translate Paid Social performance and data into clear business implications and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Lead senior stakeholder conversations, building trust, creating buy-in and constructively challenging existing approaches when the data or business opportunity calls for it.
Connect channel performance to broader business priorities, identifying where Paid Social can create the greatest impact.
Share insights and learnings to drive continuous improvement across markets.

 
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH  
You’ll work in a highly collaborative, global environment, partnering with Paid Media Specialists, Creative Production, Measurement & Analytics teams, markets, agencies and external platform partners.
As a trusted Paid Social expert, you’ll connect teams and perspectives across the organisation, helping create alignment around how the channel evolves and delivers impact across markets.
 
WHO YOU ARE  
You’re a Paid Social expert who combines deep channel knowledge with strong commercial judgement and the presence to influence at senior level. You’re comfortable moving between the details of platform performance and the bigger business picture, and you know how to turn complex information into a clear point of view and recommendation. You’re someone who takes ownership, asks the right questions and isn’t afraid to challenge established ways of working when you see an opportunity to improve. You build credibility through expertise, but you also know that driving change in a global organisation requires curiosity, collaboration and the ability to bring people with you. You communicate with clarity and confidence, adapt your message to your audience and are comfortable leading conversations with senior stakeholders. Rather than simply presenting results, you help others understand what they mean for the business, what needs to happen next and why.
We are looking for people with:
7-9 years’ experience in Paid Social, digital media or performance marketing roles.
A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics or a related field.
Strong expertise in Paid Social platforms and advertising products, such as Meta and TikTok.
A structured and analytical mindset, with experience leading Test & Learn initiatives.
The ability to translate performance data into actionable improvements and best practices.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and turning complex media and performance topics into clear business recommendations.
Strong commercial judgement and the ability to connect Paid Social performance to broader business objectives.
The confidence to lead discussions, challenge constructively and create alignment across different teams and perspectives.
The ability to communicate with impact, adapting your message to audiences ranging from channel specialists to senior leaders.
A curious, proactive approach and the ownership to move complex topics forward across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills in English.

 
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter.  
 
JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
This is a permanent position based in Stockholm. Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page. 
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Help Build the Next Generation of Mathematics Learning
Albert Group is a Nordic EdTech group developing digital education services that help children learn and grow. Through Albert Junior and Sumdog, the group has established experience in digital learning for both home and school.
Albert Group is now developing a new AI-powered mathematics platform designed to make learning more personalised, engaging and effective.
The platform will offer two complementary services. For schools, the focus is on providing teachers with better tools for instruction, classroom activities and understanding students' learning progress. For home use, a standalone service is being developed where children can learn new mathematical concepts, practise their skills and receive personalised support through AI.
Both services will work independently while also having the potential to complement each other and strengthen children's learning.
For this initiative, E-commerce Recruit is looking for a VP AI Ventures to take overall responsibility for developing the product, building the business and bringing the offering to market.
About the Role
You will take full ownership of developing the new business, from product strategy and technical priorities to launch and commercial growth.
The product is already under development. Your role will be to take it forward, establish clear priorities and ensure that technology is translated into valuable, commercially viable services.
You will lead a small team with expertise in technology and education, while also working with external developers and specialists. The role involves close collaboration with other businesses within the group and reports directly to the CEO.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Own the product strategy, roadmap and priorities for the AI-powered platform.
Lead internal developers, educational specialists and external consultants, while driving key technical decisions.
Ensure the product is grounded in relevant educational research and that technology supports learning.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies targeting both schools (B2B) and parents (B2C).
Take responsibility for the business model, positioning, pricing and commercial launch.
Drive pilot programmes and measure learning outcomes, user engagement and business performance.
Build the team and business step by step, with responsibility for budget and results.
Develop the business with international expansion in mind, initially focusing on the Nordic markets and the UK.

During your first months, you will familiarise yourself with the existing product development work and establish a clear product and go-to-market plan. The next priorities will be to launch pilots, measure results and create the conditions for acquiring paying customers.
Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for someone who has experience building, developing and launching digital products or new business areas, and who understands what it takes to turn an early-stage idea into a viable business.
You have a strong technical understanding and hands-on experience with AI-powered products. You do not need to write the code yourself, but you must be able to understand technical opportunities, challenge development teams and make well-informed decisions.
You also bring a strong commercial mindset and experience turning product ideas into offerings that customers want to use and are willing to pay for.
We believe you have:
Experience building and launching digital products, preferably within SaaS, with responsibility for both product development and commercial results.
Hands-on experience with AI products, such as LLM-based features, prompt engineering, evaluation or personalisation.
Experience leading developers, product teams or external technology partners.
Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies.
A data-driven approach based on testing hypotheses, measuring results and making informed decisions.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required.
Fluency in Swedish is highly preferred, but we welcome strong candidates who speak English only.

Experience in EdTech, consumer applications or international digital services is an advantage. A background in startups, entrepreneurship, the UK education market or data protection is also valuable.
Your Personality and Approach
To succeed in this role, you need to be comfortable operating in an environment where not all the answers are available from the start.
You are used to making decisions with limited information, testing solutions and adjusting direction based on what you learn. You know how to prioritise and recognise when a product is ready to be tested in the market.
You are equally comfortable working strategically on long-term product direction and getting hands-on to solve practical challenges alongside the development team.
You are curious, open-minded and quick to learn new subjects. You communicate effectively with technical specialists, educators and senior management alike.
What matters most is your ability to take ownership, build momentum and turn ideas into results.
About Albert Group
Albert Group is a Nordic EdTech group developing digital education services for children and students. Through brands including Albert Junior, Swedish Film and Sumdog, the group provides learning solutions for both home and school.
With experience across consumer and education markets, Albert Group has established a foundation for continued product development. The group is now taking its next step into AI-powered mathematics learning, with international ambitions.
Learn more at the-albertgroup.com (https://the-albertgroup.com/).
Location and Application
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
This recruitment is managed by E-commerce Recruit in close collaboration with Albert Group.
The recruitment process includes initial interviews and discussions with the company. For shortlisted candidates, a work-related case, assessments and reference checks may also be included.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Verksamhetsbeskrivning
Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB är beläget strax söder om Kristianstad och erbjuder skade- och lackreparationer för försäkringsbolag, företag och privatpersoner. Med omkring 65 engagerade medarbetare är vi en av regionens ledande aktörer inom bilskadereparation.

Arbetet omfattar alla typer av plåtskador, karossreparationer och plåtarbeten.

SALES/BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND MARKETING ASSOCIATE
At Enable Banking, we build the Open Banking infrastructure behind the financial products. Our mission is simple; to turn Open Banking into a relevant foundtition of companies. 

We're now looking for a Sales & Marketing Associate to help us on that mission. This is a hybrid role with a 50/50 split: half of your time goes to sales and business development, and half goes to marketing, content, and brand. 
 
A key part of this role is helping us grow beyond the EU. As we expand into new non-EU markets (such as the UK, Moldova, Serbia, Georgia, Albania, and other countries with developing Open Banking ecosystems), you'll help research these markets, build our first customer and partner relationships there, and adapt our positioning to each local context.

Role Description
As a Sales & Marketing Associate at Enable Banking, you won't just book meetings or publish posts. You'll own the link between the two: turning market insight into stories and campaigns, and turning those campaigns into qualified conversations and pipeline.
 
Because we're a small company, your impact will be immediate and visible. The content you create and the conversations you start will directly influence our pipeline, our positioning, and how we talk about our product. You'll work closely with sales, marketing, product, and leadership, helping bring financial products to market across industries such as accounting software, lending, and next-generation fintech.

Who we are
Enable Banking operates at the forefront of Open Banking. We’re an Open Banking provider operating across 29 EU countries, helping companies access high-quality financial data through one scalable API. Enable Banking is an AISP operating as a PSD2 API aggregator, integrating to all the major banks across the EU. Our customers integrate to Enable Banking’s API and gain access to all the major banks, instead of integrating to each bank individually. 

We're looking for a person who thrives on jumping into the action, tackling new challenges head on, and learning fast alongside our growing, ambitious team. Here, challenges aren’t obstacles, they’re opportunities to learn, grow, and make a real impact every day.

Sales & Business Development (50%)

Marketing & Content (50%)

- Plan and support marketing campaigns and events, and represent Enable Banking at industry events and conferences across the EU 
- Translate Open Banking use cases and market trends into clear, engaging messaging for different industries and new markets 💡
- Build go-to-market materials and campaigns for new non-EU markets, adapted to local audiences, regulation, and use cases
- Track performance across web, social, and campaigns through dashboards and analytics, and use the insights to optimise content and conversion 📈
- Work closely with sales, product, and leadership to keep messaging, positioning, and sales materials aligned 🤝

What we’re looking for:

- Experience in B2B sales, business development, or marketing, ideally in fintech, SaaS, or financial services in multinational companies.

- Understanding of, or strong interest in, financial markets and Open Banking developments outside the EU.
- A proactive, self-starting mindset. You take initiative and make things happen
- Team player attitude with a focus on win-win outcomes 

Bonus if you have:
- Experience with digitalization or digital transformation projects across the public and private sectors
- Experience working with international organisations, clients, or multicultural teams 🌍

- Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM and marketing automation tools
- Event planning, outreach, or public speaking experience
- Experience in graphic design
- Proficiency in languages relevant to our new markets, such as Russian or Georgian, is a plus

Full-time - Hybrid - Stockholm, Sweden

jobs.occupation: Rådgivare inom parkslide och kontaminerade jordmassor, Stockholmsregionen
jobs.description:
Rådgivare inom parkslide och kontaminerade jordmassor, Stockholmsregionen

Om ProGreen
ProGreen Sverige AB arbetar med att bekämpa invasiva främmande växtarter. Det är arter som parkslide, jätteloka, jättebalsamin, kanadensiskt gullris, blomsterlupin och vresros, som tränger undan inhemsk flora, skadar byggnader och infrastruktur och kostar samhället stora summor varje år. Uppdragsgivarna är kommuner, myndigheter, byggföretag, bostadsrättsföreningar, företag och privatpersoner i hela Sverige.

Arbetet omfattar hela kedjan: inventering och kartläggning av bestånd, mekanisk och kemisk bekämpning, dispensansökningar, uppföljning över flera säsonger samt rapporter och rådgivning till beställare. ProGreen arbetar långsiktigt och med fokus på att bestånden faktiskt ska försvinna, inte bara hållas tillbaka.

Varför tjänsten finns
Parkslide är en av de svåraste invasiva arterna att bli av med. Rhizomen kan sträcka sig flera meter från plantan, och mycket små fragment räcker för att arten ska etablera sig på nytt. När jord flyttas vid bygg- och markarbeten följer parkslide ofta med, och nya bestånd sprids på det sättet över stora områden. I Sverige finns i dag mycket lite praktisk kunskap om hur sådana massor ska hanteras, medan andra länder, till exempel Storbritannien, har arbetat systematiskt med frågan i många år. Därför är erfarenhet från länder där metoderna redan är etablerade särskilt värdefull.

ProGreen bygger nu upp rådgivning kring parkslidekontaminerade jordmassor som ett eget verksamhetsområde och söker en specialist som kan vägleda beställare, entreprenörer och myndigheter.

Vad jag söker
Jag söker dig som kan parkslide på djupet, ovan och under mark. Du kan bedöma en plats, avgöra hur långt rhizomen sträcker sig och förklara för beställare och entreprenörer vad som krävs för att massor ska kunna flyttas utan att arten sprids vidare. Du är lika trygg på en byggarbetsplats som i ett möte, och du är bra på att omsätta kunskap i tydliga och praktiska råd.

Du kommer att arbeta nära mig och få stort inflytande över hur verksamheten byggs upp, från metoder och rutiner till hur tjänsten erbjuds till kunderna. Tjänsten passar dig som vill vara med från början och bygga något nytt.

Arbetsuppgifter
• Bedöma platser och rhizomutbredning inför schakt- och markarbeten

Knotweed Advisor, Contaminated Soil, Stockholm, Sweden

About ProGreen
ProGreen Sverige AB controls invasive alien plant species such as Japanese knotweed, giant hogweed and Himalayan balsam. Clients include municipalities, authorities, construction companies, housing associations and homeowners across Sweden. The work covers the whole chain: surveying, mechanical and chemical control, permits, multi-year follow-up and advice, with the aim of eradication, not just suppression.

Why this role exists
Knotweed rhizome can extend several metres from the plant, and tiny fragments are enough to re-establish. When soil is moved during groundworks, knotweed moves with it. Sweden still has very little practical knowledge of handling such soil, while other countries, such as the UK, have worked on it systematically for years. ProGreen is now building this up as a dedicated advisory service and needs a specialist to guide clients and contractors.

What I am looking for
An advisor who knows knotweed above and below ground. You can assess a site, judge how far the rhizome extends and explain to clients and contractors what it takes to move soil without spreading the plant. You are confident on construction sites and in meetings, and good at turning expertise into clear, practical advice. You will work closely with me and help shape the service from the start.

Tasks
• Assess sites and rhizome extent ahead of groundworks
• Write management plans: on-site burial, encapsulation, root barriers or removal to approved facilities
• Advise clients, contractors and municipalities before and during projects
• Carry out site inspections during excavation and screening
• Develop biosecurity procedures for sites and transport
• Train contractors and machine operators
• Document work and follow up treated areas
• Develop methods, quotes and service offers

Requirements
• Experience handling knotweed-contaminated soil
• Able to identify knotweed rhizome and crowns in the field
• Experience working with contractors on excavation projects
• Good spoken and written English

Desirable
• PCA certification or equivalent
• Experience writing knotweed management plans
• Excavator experience, driving licence B, Swedish

Terms
Permanent, full time, all year round, with a 6-month probationary period. Salary and terms according to Swedish collective agreement. Start April 2027. Based in [Strängnäs/Huddinge].
